nodes.description: Price in wei required by franklessMint; settable by owner via setPrice.
Contract owner set in constructor from msg.sender; used by requiresAuth modifier.
Random seed derived from block.timestamp at deploy time, used by the internal PRNG.
Immutable reference to the external IFrank contract used for ownership proofs.
ERC2981 royalty fee in basis points, owner settable.
ERC2981 royalty recipient address, owner settable.
Array of frank name strings used in on-chain generative art.
Array of SVG animation strings embedded into token metadata.
ERC721 balance mapping updated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom/_mint/_burn.

ERC721 per-token approval mapping.

FrankLoot constructor: sets royalty values, seeds SEED from block.timestamp and assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owner-only setter for pricePerFrank, guarded by requiresAuth.
Owner-only setter for the royalty recipient, guarded by requiresAuth.
Owner-only setter for the royalty fee, guarded by requiresAuth.
Modifier enforcing owner == msg.sender before executing the decorated function.
Internal PRNG: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(SEED, input)); predictable given SEED.
Internal helper computing number of franks on a metadata line; arithmetic with % and +1.
Internal helper assembling a line of SVG art using random values and franks/shakes arrays.
Public mint() for ids 0..1999 requiring proof of ownership of a Frank, then _safeMint(msg.sender, id).
Batch version of mintWithFrank, looping over an array of Frank ids and calling _safeMint each iteration.
Payable mint for ids 2000..3999 requiring msg.value >= pricePerFrank, then _safeMint.
On-chain metadata generator building SVG and base64 JSON for a token id.
ERC165/ERC721/ERC2981 interface support function.
ERC721 internal _safeMint: mints then calls onERC721Received on the recipient, an external callback.
ERC721 transferFrom performing authorization checks and unchecked balance updates.
External ERC721TokenReceiver callback invoked after safe transfers/mints; attacker-controlled code.
msg.sender: caller address used for ownership auth, mint recipients and operator checks.
block.timestamp: used to derive SEED at construction, making randomness miner-influenceable.
External call ERC721TokenReceiver(to).onERC721Received after state updates in _safeMint - reentrancy surface.
unchecked { balanceOf[from]--; balanceOf[to]++; } in ERC721.transferFrom - unchecked arithmetic.
External call frank.ownerOf(frankId) to an untrusted IFrank contract used for access checks.
require(msg.value >= pricePerFrank) in franklessMint - value/price validation.
unchecked { balanceOf[to]++ } in ERC721._mint / ERC20._mint - unchecked arithmetic.
